name: MADA double-crop paddy lot on marine clay
region: Muda Agricultural Development Authority (MADA) granary, Kedah-Perlis plain
headline: Malaysia's rice bowl: two paddy seasons a year on canal water that runs short when the dry monsoon fails.
story: A 2.4 ha paddy lot inside the MADA scheme, planted twice a year (main season from about August, off-season from about February) with direct-seeded rice. The Muda and Pedu dams supply the water, but El Niño years such as 2016 and 2024 forced MADA to delay or cut the off-season. Continuous paddy carries planthopper, blast and weedy rice, the straw is usually burnt, and yields have plateaued near 4.5-5 t/ha a season.
challenge_tags: Off-season water shortfall in El Niño years
Rice after rice: weedy rice and planthopper

irrigation.label: MADA gravity canal (Muda/Pedu dams)
irrigation.source: Muda and Pedu reservoirs via the MADA canal network

baseline_rotation.name: Paddy - paddy (two seasons a year)
baseline_rotation.note: Sentinel-2 shows two green-up and harvest cycles every year since 2020, matching the MADA two-season calendar.

water_context.in_situ_source: MADA and JPS reservoir storage reports, Muda and Pedu dams
water_context.note: Water comes from surface reservoirs, not groundwater. When Muda and Pedu storage falls below about 40% at the end of the dry monsoon (Jan-Mar), MADA delays the off-season or rotates supply between blocks.

rice.note: BERNAS-licensed mills buy at the government floor price; input and price subsidies apply.

grain_maize.note: Feed mills in Kedah and Penang take local grain corn under the national grain-corn programme, but need a dryer.

sweet_corn.note: Pasar tani and roadside sellers along the Alor Setar corridor.

mung_bean.note: Small market; a buyer or cooperative has to be arranged before planting.

groundnut.note: Local snack processors; most groundnut is imported.

watermelon.note: Middlemen collect for the northern wholesale markets.
